title: Type the Change plan
description: A proposed sequence of exact replacements that the user types manually. Existing files only; anchors must be unique at the point each step starts.

file.description: Workspace-relative file path using forward slashes. No absolute paths, parent traversal, hidden credential directories, .env files, or private keys.

before.description: Exact, unique existing code at this step, including indentation and enough surrounding context. Use LF line endings. For insertion, include surrounding existing text.

after.description: Complete replacement code that the user will type, including retained context and indentation. May be empty for deletion. Must differ from before. Use LF line endings.

reason.description: Briefly explain why this edit serves the user's intent. Text equality is not proof of semantic correctness.
